snippet.title: Skiing Fred - Now on Google Play!
snippet.description:
Enter the perfect chaos of Skiing Fred...

The more dangerously you slide, the bigger the reward!
Slide turbo-speed, dodge and drift through Fred's trap-ridden world as he escapes Grimmy Reaper. 

- Free-style control system unlike any other game
- Compete and help your friends!
- Tons of challenging missions
- Customize and gear up your character!
- Massive Cooperative Missions
- Tons of insane vehicles
- Dozens of traps and enemies
- The best Fred Game ever!

A sequel to Falling Fred and Running Fred, Skiing Fred is an over-the-top action-sports game featuring an unique free-movement system that allows you to take control of the action and perform true skill-based special moves.
Get daring! Get creative! Get an edge over your friends and enjoy the best speeder mobile game experience... or get them to help you beat massive Challenges destroying any enemies on your way. You´ll be facing of extreme storms,
apocalyptic meteor showers and blinding blizzards. 

Whether looking to beat a friend's record, complete a mission, unlock achievements o get that particular item set collection, Skiing Fred packs a full load of fun for everyone!

Next update features: UHD graphics for higher end devices, enhanced social functionalities and VERSUS mode!
